description: Returns the top 10 of the Buildix Top Traders ranking of large Hyperliquid accounts: address, label, Trader Score, confidence, style badge and, once the ranking exists, the official rank, Verified flag, Follow Score (what a follower copying 10 minutes late would have kept, adjusted for risk and sample size), follower PnL over 30 days and rank 24 hours ago. Wallets with a losing lifetime record, market makers and hedged books are not ranked. Position changes under $50,000 are not seen. Use it when the user asks which Hyperliquid wallets to study before copy trading. Data only: Buildix does not execute trades.

detail.description: "brief" (default) returns labels and key numbers. "full" adds the underlying values, data age and method notes.

name: get_top_traders
title: Top traders by Follow Score
